$comment: Drain-side batching controls enqueue cadence without changing GitHub rulesets; precedence per key is env > repo > platform > standard, and invalid values fall through. enabled (standard false, WE_MQ_BATCHING_ENABLED) enables batching, groupSize (3, WE_MQ_BATCHING_GROUP_SIZE) limits groups to 1..5 PRs, groupFormMinutes (5, WE_MQ_BATCHING_GROUP_FORM_MINUTES) closes a group when full or its forming time elapses, and maxGroupsInFlight (1, WE_MQ_BATCHING_MAX_GROUPS_IN_FLIGHT) caps active groups. failureThreshold (3, WE_MQ_BATCHING_FAILURE_THRESHOLD) failures within failureWindowMinutes (120, WE_MQ_BATCHING_FAILURE_WINDOW_MINUTES) trigger strict single-PR groups for strictModeMinutes (60, WE_MQ_BATCHING_STRICT_MODE_MINUTES). Failed groups are isolated one PR at a time to identify culprits. isolateTimeoutMinutes (60, WE_MQ_BATCHING_ISOLATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES; positive integer) bounds each recovery member independently; closed and draft members leave on observation. Failed groups and culprit history expire after failureWindowMinutes. Pending enqueue reservations expire after five minutes; late confirmations restore singleton tracking. cancelIntermediateRuns (auto, WE_MQ_BATCHING_CANCEL_INTERMEDIATE_RUNS; auto|on|off) requires authoritative native group membership and tip, plus HEADGREEN under auto. Admission order and queue position do not prove these boundaries, so the current shell retains runs under auto and on. HEADGREEN replay savings remain hypothetical projections. rulesetId (24883772, WE_MQ_BATCHING_RULESET_ID) identifies the ruleset for read-only inspection. Repo values: enabled true and groupSize 3 per the operator GO 2026-10-13; maxGroupsInFlight 5 (2026-10-14, was 2) matches GitHub max_entries_to_build 5: fast drains take 5-9 min, longer than the 5-min form window, so each group closed with 1 PR and a cap of 2 throttled throughput to about 2 PRs per CI cycle with 16 ready PRs deferred; 5 restores pre-batching parallelism while culprit recovery and strict mode are unchanged.
